scope: Independent T9 software preparation; no real calibration, policy enablement, full suite, GPU, cloud, network or commits.

verification.mypy: PASS (6 owned source files; unrelated override-unused note)
verification.real_capture_cli: exit 2 INCOMPLETE: dedicated risk supervision is required

public_interfaces.RiskEstimate: failure_probability: float|None, failure_probability_by_action: Mapping[str,float|None], geometric_error_bound_m: float|None, motion_bound_m_s: float|None, status: VALID|UNKNOWN
public_interfaces.RiskModelArtifact: model_hash, model_path, calibration_path, fit_group_ids, calibration_group_ids, feature_schema
public_interfaces.artifact_storage: fit writes hash-checked model.json in /tmp; calibration path pins its content digest; genuine CLI copies accepted artifacts to --output

required_real_sources.dataset: COMPLETE committed T6 SampleRecords with verified camera payloads; reports/split_audit.json and all four disjoint group/source/episode/content splits; payload-backed quality is rerun.

risk_supervision.failure: actual independent offline bool, never status/positive/confidence
risk_supervision.geometric_error_m: actual independent estimator-vs-truth absolute error, offline only
risk_supervision.previous_sample_id: actual earlier source frame in same group and same partition
risk_supervision.motion_error_m_s: actual nonnegative residual above measured motion proxy, only used with valid fresh timestamped pairs
risk_supervision.action_outcomes: optional action => {evidence_key: committed feedback payload key}; absent action remains None

executed_feedback.independent_result_sha256: SHA256 of raw independent result payload

required_real_sources.independent_action_result: source=INDEPENDENT_EVALUATOR; action_id matches real action, action matches DecisionAction, next_observation_checksum matches actual later RGBDObservation, failure matches feedback; real action timestamps bracketed by the two fresh frames.

acceptance.initial_protocol_hash: content hash of separately loaded existing INITIAL protocol
acceptance.independent_label_refs: list of {path, sha256}; each risk.supervision.v1 raw source has evaluator_hash and records mapping

required_real_sources.independent_label_record: sample_id => {observation_id, risk_supervision, raw_evaluation_ref, raw_evaluation_sha256}; exact coverage and matching sample supervision required.
required_real_sources.raw_risk_evaluation: source=INDEPENDENT_EVALUATOR, observation_checksum, failure bool, geometric_error_m, motion_error_m_s, calibration_residuals_m; all match actual bound labels.
required_real_sources.initial: Provide --initial-protocol DIR; existing load_protocol validates protocol.json content hash and required source/pool/opportunity/recovery bindings; acceptance must match INITIAL content hash.
required_real_sources.calibration_sample_sufficiency: At coverage .9 finite conformal bound requires at least 9 independent labeled groups; geometry and motion are counted separately; both failure classes required in fit and probability calibration; calibrated CONTINUE needs real executed outcomes in train and calibration.
required_real_sources.selection: Default config selection_status remains NOT_RUN. Selection hyperparameters must be independently chosen/frozen before production use; CLI does not choose weights or thresholds from test.

integration: T10 can consume RiskEstimate error/motion bounds only with VALID; missing source acceptance, calibration, frame freshness, valid depth, matching calibration or supported depth/residual domain returns UNKNOWN and None.
T10 remains responsible for current observation age, expected duration, context/plan/mode identities and SafetyShield; extraction uses unchanged acquisition timestamps and never updates old crops.
T11/T12 must disable any physical action with None action probability; LOCAL_RECOVER remains unavailable until actual T13 executed feedback and independent calibration exist.
No runtime integration or real method enablement performed; unit fixtures marked accepted only inside tests do not represent research evidence.
limitations: Software unit fixtures prove implementation behavior, never actual calibration quality or sufficient dataset evidence.
Image/depth consistency is a bounded scene-motion proxy; actual motion residual labels are mandatory to calibrate its errors.
Observable support guard covers depth median/dispersion, calibration residuals, acquisition interval and calibration identity; it does not claim universal OOD detection.
Calibration-set reliability plots are explicitly labeled as such and are not independent evaluation. Test evaluation remains NOT_RUN.
No genuine source acceptance or INITIAL protocol was present for this software handoff.
